scripts.dev: uv run alembic upgrade head && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker,gateway -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter @geoscalex/web dev" "uv run uvicorn geoscalex.api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "uv run python -m geoscalex.worker.main" "pnpm --filter @geoscalex/model-gateway dev"
scripts.test: uv run pytest && pnpm --filter @geoscalex/web test -- --run && pnpm --filter @geoscalex/model-gateway test
scripts.check: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src && pnpm --filter @geoscalex/web check && pnpm --filter @geoscalex/model-gateway check
